title: Dedicated capacity weekly prep - EV
content:
Weekly prep notes for dedicated capacity sync (1:1 + weekly ops).

Date: 2026-03-04 (sync 10:00a)
Attendees: Evelyn (owner), Jordan, Maya, Ravi (SRE), Finance TBD

Goals for this meeting:
- Review 6-week GPU pool forecast and reservation requests.
- Confirm autoscaling policy changes for burst windows.
- Identify shortfall risks and mitigation (fallback routing, cross-region).
- Actions for finance approval on increased reserved capacity.

Current state / quick summary:
- Prod GPU pools: 12x A100-80GB equivalent across two regions (us-west-2 primary, eu-west-1 secondary).
- Current committed reservations: 9 GPUs reserved (dedicated product customers), 3 shared for hosted bursts.
- Observed peak weekly utilization: 78% avg over last 2 weeks; peak 94% during batch evaluation runs (INF-2345).
- Autoscale config: scale-up threshold 70% sustained for 3m, scale-down after 10m idle. Max nodes per pool = 16.
- Recent incidents: 2026-02-26 short outage during model rollout caused elevated queueing; root cause: KV cache invalidation + dense eval job spawned during canary.

Forecast notes (6-week)
- Baseline growth: +10% w/o new customers (organic traffic + scheduled eval windows).
- Known commitments: two Dedicated customers planning to ramp in April (est +4 GPUs equivalent each) => +8 GPUs by 2026-04-15. Linked JIRA: INF-2410 (sales ramp).
- Expected internal spikes: monthly deep-eval on 2026-03-20 (heavy KV scan) -> reserve temporary burst capacity or schedule off-peak.

Scenarios and recommendations:
1) Conservative (no new commits): keep current reservations, increase burst pool to 6 GPUs from 3 for two weeks around 2026-03-20. Rationale: avoid conversion to reservations; cost contained.
2) Moderate (one customer ramps): add 4 GPU reservation starting 2026-04-01; update autoscale max nodes to 20 for us-west-2; enable cross-region fallback to eu-west-1 for non-sensitive workloads.
3) Aggressive (two customers ramp): accelerate reservation approval for +8 GPUs, negotiate 60-day notice for finance; pre-warm images on additional nodes to reduce cold-start latency.

Autoscaling proposal (actionable items):
- Short-term change: lower scale-up threshold to 60% during business hours (8a-8p) to reduce queuing risk; keep scale-down at 10m. (Risk: slightly higher cost). Owner: Ravi. JIRA: INF-2452.
- Batching tuning: enable continuous batching for chat endpoints with min-batch 4 during peak windows to reduce per-token cost. Owner: Maya.
- Burst policy: add scheduled burst reservation window (72h) that can be toggled per pool for known evals. Owner: Evelyn.

Risk register / mitigations:
- Reservation lead time (finance approval slow) -> mitigation: temporary spot-burst or short-term cloud reservations (cross-account) + alert to sales to pause ramp. Owner: Evelyn + Finance.
- Hot KV cache churn during model rollouts -> mitigation: canary rollout with KV warming, preflight tests on staging with same cache sizes. Owner: Jordan.
- Cross-region data residency constraints for some customers -> mitigation: restrict fallback for those customers to private pools only; document mapping. Owner: Solutions Eng.

Open questions to raise in sync:
- Finance: acceptable commit window for +8 GPUs? Who signs off? (trace to INF-2410)
- Sales: can the ramp be delayed by 2-3 weeks if capacity cannot be reserved?
- SRE: do we have capacity to pre-warm N=8 nodes in us-west-2 by 2026-03-18? Cost/time estimate?

Action items (with owners & due dates):
- A1: Create short-term autoscale change PR (lower scale-up threshold to 60% business hours). Owner: Ravi. Due: 2026-03-06. Linked: INF-2452.
- A2: Draft reservation request for +4 GPUs (moderate scenario) and cost estimate for finance. Owner: Evelyn. Due: 2026-03-08.
- A3: Schedule pre-warm job and test KV warming steps for canary. Owner: Jordan. Due: 2026-03-12.
- A4: Batch tuning experiment plan (min-batch 4 -> measure latency/cost tradeoffs). Owner: Maya. Due: 2026-03-10.
- A5: Update runbook to include burst toggle and cross-region fallback decision tree. Owner: Ravi + Solutions Eng. Due: 2026-03-15.

Notes / misc links:
- See INF-2345 for the evaluation job that produced the recent spike.
- Confluence: dedicated-capacity-runbook (link in metadata).
- Slack thread: #dedicated-capacity (pinned message recap 2026-02-27).

Prep talking points for the 1:1 with Ravi:
- Emphasize risk of queuing at 70-80% sustained; propose immediate threshold change to 60% for 2 weeks and measure.
- Ask for quick cost estimate for pre-warming 8 nodes (hours to boot + image pull).
- Confirm SLO impacts for higher max nodes (20) and how autoscaler handles sudden concurrent scale-ups.

Follow-up cadence:
- Weekly sync follow-ups to review action items (EOD Friday checklist).
- Trigger a mid-week emergency sync if queueing > 5min or if any customer-facing latency regression detected.

Quick checklist to bring to meeting:
- [ ] PR for autoscale threshold change (INF-2452)
- [ ] Reservation draft + cost estimate (+4 GPUs)
- [ ] Pre-warm schedule & KV warming plan
- [ ] Batch tuning experiment plan
- [ ] Updated runbook snippet for burst toggle

End of notes.
